centre.name: Salvation Army Sudbury
centre.about_html:
Salvation Army – Sudbury is a rehab center situated in Sudbury, Ontario, Canada. This facility aims to assist individuals in overcoming substance, drug, and alcohol addiction. They provide an inclusive environment where individuals can receive compassion and specialized addiction care.

Specialties:

The rehab center has various specialty programs centered on the clients’ unique needs. One of their key programs is the 12 step program. It involves counseling and training sessions, which utilize various techniques and philosophies to help addicts overcome addiction. This program aims to establish lifelong sobriety for clients.

 

Another specialty program at Salvation Army – Sudbury is substance abuse treatment. This program provides addiction recovery services to individuals battling substance abuse. Treatment plans are customized to meet each client’s needs.

Therapies:

Salvation Army – Sudbury offers holistic therapy as one of its treatments. In this therapy, clients undergo a hands-on approach to improve their physical and spiritual health. The treatment aims to help individuals create balance, harmony, and overall wellness in their lives.

 

Another therapy offered is evidence-based practices. This therapy involves integrating scientifically proven methods of treatment to help clients overcome addiction. These methods may include motivational interviewing and cognitive-behavioral therapy.

 

Other therapeutic techniques that the rehab center offers are yoga and meditation, which help clients manage stress and anxiety. Furthermore, individual counseling and therapy provide an opportunity for a more personalized approach to treatment. Family therapy and counseling involve group activities aimed at improving family relationships.

 

Group therapy and counseling involve sessions where individuals in the rehab center come together to share their experiences with addiction. Nutritional counseling helps individuals maintain a healthy diet while in the rehabilitation process. Lastly, the Art and nature therapy provide creative outlets for individuals to explore different forms of expression.



Salvation Army Sudbury - Center Overview

Salvation Army – Sudbury is a non-profit rehabilitation center that specializes in the treatment and care of individuals struggling with substance, drug and alcohol addiction in Sudbury, Ontario. The center is dedicated to providing a welcoming and supportive environment for individuals seeking help through the journey of recovery. With a variety of programs, patients can receive tailor-made treatment approaches and individualized care to achieve successful outcomes.

The center offers admission for senior citizens, adults and young adults, with specialized programs for men, the elderly, and adults. The staff members are experienced and competent in handling various needs of patients with drug and substance abuse disorders, providing therapeutic interventions and counseling sessions to guide them through the recovery process. The Salvation Army – Sudbury aims to empower and educate patients, and to prevent recurrence of addiction by providing valuable support and aftercare services to patients and their families.

raw_html:
Salvation Army – Sudbury is a rehab center situated in Sudbury, Ontario, Canada. This facility aims to assist individuals in overcoming substance, drug, and alcohol addiction. They provide an inclusive environment where individuals can receive compassion and specialized addiction care.

Specialties:

The rehab center has various specialty programs centered on the clients’ unique needs. One of their key programs is the 12 step program. It involves counseling and training sessions, which utilize various techniques and philosophies to help addicts overcome addiction. This program aims to establish lifelong sobriety for clients.

 

Another specialty program at Salvation Army – Sudbury is substance abuse treatment. This program provides addiction recovery services to individuals battling substance abuse. Treatment plans are customized to meet each client’s needs.

Therapies:

Salvation Army – Sudbury offers holistic therapy as one of its treatments. In this therapy, clients undergo a hands-on approach to improve their physical and spiritual health. The treatment aims to help individuals create balance, harmony, and overall wellness in their lives.

 

Another therapy offered is evidence-based practices. This therapy involves integrating scientifically proven methods of treatment to help clients overcome addiction. These methods may include motivational interviewing and cognitive-behavioral therapy.

 

Other therapeutic techniques that the rehab center offers are yoga and meditation, which help clients manage stress and anxiety. Furthermore, individual counseling and therapy provide an opportunity for a more personalized approach to treatment. Family therapy and counseling involve group activities aimed at improving family relationships.

 

Group therapy and counseling involve sessions where individuals in the rehab center come together to share their experiences with addiction. Nutritional counseling helps individuals maintain a healthy diet while in the rehabilitation process. Lastly, the Art and nature therapy provide creative outlets for individuals to explore different forms of expression.



Salvation Army Sudbury - Center Overview

Salvation Army – Sudbury is a non-profit rehabilitation center that specializes in the treatment and care of individuals struggling with substance, drug and alcohol addiction in Sudbury, Ontario. The center is dedicated to providing a welcoming and supportive environment for individuals seeking help through the journey of recovery. With a variety of programs, patients can receive tailor-made treatment approaches and individualized care to achieve successful outcomes.

The center offers admission for senior citizens, adults and young adults, with specialized programs for men, the elderly, and adults. The staff members are experienced and competent in handling various needs of patients with drug and substance abuse disorders, providing therapeutic interventions and counseling sessions to guide them through the recovery process. The Salvation Army – Sudbury aims to empower and educate patients, and to prevent recurrence of addiction by providing valuable support and aftercare services to patients and their families.
